reason: A theme management plugin that adds theme settings, built-in and custom themes, one-click switching, UI customization hooks, and disk persistence; human review is warranted because uploaded JavaScript executes directly in the page.

summaries.zh: 在设置中管理内置和自定义界面主题，支持上传并切换主题脚本，同时将主题数据持久化到磁盘。
summaries.en: Manage built-in and custom interface themes from settings, with theme script uploads, one-click switching, and disk persistence.

capabilities: direct execution of uploaded JavaScript in the page
theme switching and UI component registration
disk persistence of uploaded theme files and metadata
HTTP GET/POST routes for theme data
